scope: Process-scoped proxies; NO physical frequency modification or background network traffic in these ten tests; fail-stop excluded. Compute reuses completed raw logs; communication is new size-2 expert-DP AllReduce stream delay.
primary_rule: FLASH engineering extension (cross-validation) is the preferred runtime; paper text CV/minimum and 20% placement interpretation retained as distinct replay baselines
severity_denominator: Report both latency increase and throughput loss; paper does not fully specify denominator. Planned labels are approximate latency-increase targets, not claimed measured paper strength.
